name: NavigationMenuViewport
description: Combines `NavigationMenu.PortalPrimitive`, `NavigationMenu.PositionerPrimitive`, `NavigationMenu.PopupPrimitive`, and `NavigationMenu.ViewportPrimitive` into a single part. Use `portalElement`, `positionerElement`, or `popupElement` to replace the portal, positioner, or popup. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: popupElement
props.description: Replaces the default `NavigationMenu.PopupPrimitive`. Use to change the panel that holds the content.

props.name: portalElement
props.description: Replaces the default `NavigationMenu.PortalPrimitive`. Use to change the portal container.

props.name: positionerElement
props.description: Replaces the default `NavigationMenu.PositionerPrimitive`. Use to change the side, alignment, or offset of the popup.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: NavigationMenu.Viewport.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
